The constraints force one block and one pair. Gus is immediately after Hana, and Finn is two slots after Hana, so those three occupy Hana–Gus–Finn in order. Ben is immediately after Cara, and both sit before that block; Ben is at least three slots from Gus, so Ben ends at least two slots before Hana. Ivo is before Gus and at least three slots from Hana, so Ivo is at least three slots before Hana. Dev is before both Hana and Ben. Ann is before Ben, at least three slots from Ben, with exactly one slot between Ann and Dev.

The only start that leaves room for those four is Hana in 7 (Gus in 8, Finn in 9). The earlier slots then lock as Ann, Ivo, Dev, Cara, Ben. The remaining person is Eve in the only open slot.
